Tooltip_DanTraits_Inhaler:
Rescue inhaler.
Treats: asthma attacks.
Dose: 1 puff when your
airway tightens. Works at once.
Side effects: heart races
briefly; a diabetic's blood
sugar rises a little.
10 puffs.
Tooltip_DanTraits_InsulinPen:
Rapid-acting insulin.
Treats: diabetes.
Dose: 1 dose lowers blood
sugar by about 50 over
4 hours.
Side effects: too much drops
blood sugar dangerously low.
40 doses.
Tooltip_DanTraits_GlucoseMeter: Reads blood sugar from a drop of blood. Needs test strips.
Tooltip_DanTraits_TestStrips: For a glucose meter. One strip per reading. 25 strips.
Tooltip_DanTraits_Metformin:
Daily diabetes pill.
Treats: Type 2 diabetes.
Dose: 1 pill a day.
Full effect after 2 days.
Fades if you miss doses.
Side effects (rare):
upset stomach.
Too many: nausea.
30 pills.
Tooltip_DanTraits_InsulinShort: Not enough left in the pen.
Tooltip_DanTraits_NotDiabetic: You have no reason to take this.
Tooltip_DanTraits_IronPills:
Iron supplement.
Treats: anaemia.
Dose: 1 pill a day.
Side effects (rare):
mild nausea.
30 pills.
Tooltip_DanTraits_NicotineGum:
Nicotine gum.
Treats: cigarette cravings.
Dose: chew 1 piece when a
craving hits. Works at once.
Quitting still takes
3 weeks without tobacco.
Side effects: none.
10 pieces.
Tooltip_DanTraits_Anticonvulsants:
Daily epilepsy pill.
Treats: epilepsy.
Dose: 1 pill every 12 hours.
Full effect after 5 days.
Fades if you miss doses.
Side effects (rare):
drowsiness.
Too many: heavy, sluggish.
30 pills.
Tooltip_DanTraits_Sunblock: Rub it in and the sun can't burn bare skin for 8 hours. Does nothing for a burn you already have. 8 coats.
Tooltip_DanTraits_Diazepam:
Anti-anxiety pill.
Treats: panic and anxiety.
Dose: 1 pill calms panic
quickly, for about 90 min.
Side effects (rare):
drowsiness.
Too many: can barely keep
your eyes open.
20 pills.
Tooltip_DanTraits_PillsBeta:
Daily heart pill.
Treats: Heart Condition.
Dose: 1 pill a day.
Full effect after 3 days.
Fades if you miss doses.
Does not calm panic.
Side effects (rare):
stamina recovers slower.
Too many: dizzy, fainting.
30 pills.
Tooltip_DanTraits_PillsAntiDep:
Daily antidepressant.
Treats: depression.
Dose: 1 pill a day.
Full effect after 2 weeks.
Stopping suddenly after a
week brings a few rough days.
Side effects (rare):
queasiness.
30 pills.
Tooltip_DanTraits_Painkillers:
Painkillers.
Treats: pain, headaches,
migraines, hangovers,
gut flares, arthritis.
Dose: 1 or 2 pills.
Work for a few hours.
Side effects: none.
Tooltip_DanTraits_SleepingTablets:
Sleeping tablets.
Treats: trouble sleeping.
Dose: 1 at bedtime.
Light won't wake you.
Side effects: drowsiness.
Tooltip_DanTraits_Vitamins:
Caffeine pills.
Treats: tiredness.
Dose: 1 for a burst of
energy. Eases caffeine
withdrawal.
Side effects: a little stress;
light wakes you more easily.
